subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the adult woman in the uploaded image, including her identity, hairstyle, body proportions, and complete visible outfit. Preserve her facial proportions, natural skin tone, very long dark hair with a near-center part, and loose strands falling across her face. Preserve the deep navy floral halter top with small neckline bows, side openings and ties, loose cream trousers, pale beige cardigan draped around her forearms, and bare feet. Keep the same garment construction, floral placement, colors, and fabric character throughout. Do not add accessories or replace any clothing.

<Subject 2> is the seaside setting in the same uploaded image: white stucco walls, curved white stair edges, irregular stone-inlaid steps, softly blurred pink flowers and green leaves in the foreground, dark shoreline rocks, a blue-gray sea, a pale sky, and warm backlit sunlight reflecting on the water. This is the only physical location.

summary:
[reference generation] Create an exactly 15.00-second, 16:9, 24fps high-energy character-reveal trailer with exactly 13 distinct shots and 12 shot-boundary cuts. Preserve <Subject 1> in her original clothing within <Subject 2>. Combine AAA motion-graphics title design, premium editorial fashion cinematography, and explosive character-reveal editing. The theme is "SCARLET RIOT", the initials are "SR", and the tagline is "TOO HOT TO STAY STILL." Scarlet belongs to the typography and graphic effects, while the reference clothing and seaside colors remain intact.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 2]–[Shot 8] and [Shot 10]–[Shot 12]): fully_preserved - retain identity, facial geometry, skin tone, body proportions, hair length and parting, navy floral halter top, cream trousers, draped beige cardigan, and bare feet. Change only natural expressions, restrained poses, and viewing angles.

<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 2]–[Shot 12]): fully_preserved - retain the same white coastal steps and walls, foreground flowers and leaves, sea, shoreline rocks, sunlight direction, and spatial relationships. Graphic shots may abstract these features into silhouettes or masked crops without introducing another location.

detailed_description:
The film combines photorealistic coastal fashion footage with bold flat motion graphics. Approximately 80% of the energy comes from animated graphics and editing, and 20% from restrained character actions. Scarlet red, burgundy, cream, black, and champagne-gold graphic accents surround the original navy clothing, cream trousers, beige cardigan, blue-gray sea, and pink flowers. Do not recolor the outfit or turn the whole scene red.

Recompose the portrait reference naturally for 16:9 using wider views of the same setting and intentional close-ups. Never stretch the woman or distort the architecture. Pure graphic backgrounds are design plates, not physical scene changes.

[Shot 1] A static cream graphic plate opens with oversized "S" and "R" slamming into place. Scarlet circles, torn-paper edges, and halftone fragments expand around silhouettes of the reference's curved white steps. A dry impact punctuates the opening.

[Shot 2] At 00:00.750, hard cut to an extreme close-up of <Subject 1>'s closed eyes and loose dark strands, framed inside a curved scarlet aperture derived from the stair edges in <Subject 2>. Warm backlight outlines her hair. She slowly opens her eyes; a small, fast push-in meets a shutter click.

[Shot 3] At 00:01.500, hard cut to giant "SR" letter masks revealing a medium-full portrait. She stands on the same steps, one hand lightly touching the white wall and the other near her hair. Her navy floral top, cream trousers, and draped cardigan remain visible. The graphic mask slides across her still pose with a short whoosh.

[Shot 4] At 00:02.500, hard cut to a fixed split-screen of her face, floral garment detail, and bare feet on the stone-inlaid steps. "SCARLET HOUR" holds across a cream band. She settles into a relaxed freeze while paired shutter clicks accent the panels.

[Shot 5] At 00:03.500, hard cut to a centered close-up inside a rotating text ring reading "SOFT LIGHT", "HARD STARE", and "SCARLET FEVER". Sea reflections remain behind her. She lifts her gaze toward the lens; the ring rotates briefly, then settles for reading with a circular sweep sound.

[Shot 6] At 00:04.750, hard cut to an asymmetric editorial card: her waist-up portrait on the right and giant "SCARLET" on the left. Blurred flowers overlap the foreground; torn-paper and gold-foil accents sit behind the lettering. She gently lowers her raised hand toward her shoulder with a soft fabric rustle.

[Shot 7] At 00:06.000, hard cut to a tight three-quarter profile against the same sea. She makes a small head turn toward the camera, allowing her long hair to sweep naturally. An unlettered scarlet contour arc follows the motion. A short whip-pan settles into a calm freeze.

[Shot 8] At 00:07.000, hard cut to a fixed four-quadrant graphic grid reading "HOT", "SHARP", "CHIC", and "WILD". All four words remain readable while rhythmic highlights activate them in sequence. A narrow portrait strip shows her steady gaze; four percussive ticks accent the layout.

[Shot 9] At 00:08.000, hard cut to a black graphic field containing cream silhouettes of the reference's white stair curves, a cropped sea texture, and scarlet stamp-like borders. No farmhouse, car, or new landscape appears. A stamp impact triggers a brief graphic shake.

[Shot 10] At 00:09.000, hard cut to a frontal medium portrait on the same stairs. She leans slightly toward the lens while transparent graphic panes fracture outward, revealing "S" followed by "R". Only the graphic overlay breaks. The wall, sea, and clothing remain stable; a small push-in meets a crystalline impact.

[Shot 11] At 00:10.000, hard cut to one fixed four-poster grid using her portrait, the navy floral top, the white stone-inlaid steps, and the sea with foreground flowers. Four layouts animate inside their panels without additional cuts or visible numbers. Paper snaps accent the sequential panel activation.

[Shot 12] At 00:11.500, hard cut to a centered medium-full hero portrait. She stands barefoot on the same steps, subtly lifts her chin, and holds direct eye contact. Concentric scarlet shockwave graphics expand behind her, while cream graphic mattes simplify parts of the background and leave the sea and stair edges visible. A slight pull-out and bass impact mark the climax.

[Shot 13] At 00:13.000, hard cut to the final cream identity card with faint stair-curve and sea-reflection textures. Huge "SR" appears first, then scales down within the same continuous layout. By 00:13.250, "SCARLET RIOT" and "TOO HOT TO STAY STILL." are fully readable and remain steady until the video ends exactly at 00:15.000. A final impact resolves into a short decay.

Every shot must have a distinct composition. Use hard cuts, snap zooms, short whip pans, freezes, foreground wipes, light-leak splits, restrained impact shakes, and graphic speed ramps. Internal animations must not introduce additional shot cuts. Keep typography sharp and readable before overlap.

The only readable text permitted is "S", "R", "SR", "SCARLET HOUR", "SOFT LIGHT", "HARD STARE", "SCARLET FEVER", "SCARLET", "HOT", "SHARP", "CHIC", "WILD", "SCARLET RIOT", and "TOO HOT TO STAY STILL." Do not display "TURN", poster numbers, or any other text.

No dancing, face drift, character replacement, hairstyle redesign, wardrobe changes, red plaid blazer, tie, mini skirt, boots, added jewelry, vintage car, farmhouse, green field, extra people, duplicated bodies, malformed hands, cartoon rendering, cheap CGI, vlog styling, illegible text, messy layouts, watermarks, subtitles, UI, or brand logos.

Final feel: the same woman in the same navy floral outfit and cream trousers, standing in the same sunlit coastal setting, transformed through composition, typography, and motion design into the heroine of "SCARLET RIOT".

overall_soundscape:
Gentle sea waves and a light coastal breeze continue beneath soft fabric movement and occasional barefoot contact with the stone steps. Synchronized graphic impacts, shutter clicks, paper snaps, whooshes, and stamp sounds follow the shot timeline. No dialogue, voice-over, or singing.

non_diegetic_music:
An instrumental fashion-trailer track at 144 BPM combines punchy electronic drums, tight sub-bass, clipped metallic percussion, and short synth accents. Brief rhythmic gaps emphasize the reveals, followed by a stronger hero accent at 00:11.500 and a final resolving hit at 00:13.000 that decays naturally through 00:15.000.

transition_step	低分辨率阶段的采样次数。5 表示前 5 次在低分辨率完成，剩余次数在高分辨率完成。越晚切换通常越快，但细节恢复余地更少。
lowres_scale	低分辨率阶段相对目标尺寸的比例。0.50 表示宽、高各减半，面积约为目标的 ¼；越小越省计算，但可能丢失结构和细节。
rho	参与 VAE 校正的位置比例。0.50 表示选择差异最大的约 50% 时空位置；范围越大，校正越广，也可能更平滑。0 关闭校正。不是越大越好，rho 控制校正范围，不是画质等级。 调大意味着更多位置向 VAE 参考结果靠近，可能减少放大伪影，也可能抹掉原本清晰的纹理。
w_min	被选位置的最低校正权重。0.50 表示至少以 50% 权重向 VAE 结果靠近。
w_max	被选位置的最高校正权重。1.00 表示差异最大的位置可以完全采用 VAE 结果。

`transition_step` specifies the number of samples in the low-resolution phase. 5 indicates that the first 5 samples are taken at low resolution, and the remaining samples are taken at high resolution. Later transitions are generally faster, but offer less room for detail recovery.
`lowres_scale` is the ratio of the target size to the overall size at low resolution. 0.50 means the width and height are each halved, resulting in an area approximately ¼ of the target. Smaller values ​​save computation but may lose structure and detail.
rho represents the proportion of locations involved in VAE correction. 0.50 indicates selecting approximately 50% of the spatiotemporal locations with the greatest differences; a larger range results in a wider correction and potentially smoother results. 0 disables correction. A larger value is not always better.
w_min is the minimum correction weight for the selected position. 0.50 indicates that the position should be at least 50% weighted towards the VAE result.
w_max is the highest correction weight for the selected location. 1.00 indicates that the location with the greatest difference can fully utilize the VAE results.

Young Korean woman, early 20s, oversized soft cardigan over shorts, hair loose and slightly messy, relaxed sleepy expression, natural unguarded energy.
Location:
Small backyard with a hammock strung between two trees, early afternoon. Dappled sunlight through leaves, a small side table with a book, quiet garden sounds. No modern clutter.
Visual Style:
Ultra-realistic documentary realism, intimate candid feeling, soft warm afternoon light.
Camera Style:
Early 2000s DV camcorder, handheld gentle drift, autofocus adjusting slowly to shifting light through leaves, warm faded color cast, soft grain. No stabilization.
Timeline (30 sec):
00:00–00:03 → She climbs into the hammock carefully, adjusting her position.
00:03–00:06 → She picks up a book from the side table, flipping to her page.
00:06–00:09 → She reads quietly for a moment, then yawns softly.
00:09–00:12 → She sets the book on her stomach, then closes her eyes briefly.
00:12–00:15 → A breeze sways the hammock gently; she smiles without opening her eyes.
00:15–00:18 → She peeks one eye open at camera saying "여기 진짜 시원하다" ("It's really cool here").
00:18–00:21 → She stretches one arm lazily, then lets it dangle off the hammock.
00:21–00:24 → Dappled light shifts across her face as leaves move overhead.
00:24–00:27 → She murmurs sleepily, then closes her eyes again, fully relaxed.
00:27–00:30 → She whispers to camera "나 좀 잘게..." ("I'm going to sleep a bit..."), drifting off as it fades.
Audio:
Leaves rustling, hammock creaking softly, distant birds, faint wind. Her dialogue as noted above. No music.
Goal: A calm, drowsy afternoon rest moment intimate, soft, deeply believable.

For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic Korean romance-drama style. Preserve the vertical framing, golden ginkgo trees, stone wall, autumn daylight, the woman’s denim jacket and black trousers, the man’s brown jacket and notebook, their positions facing each other, and the bottom-screen graphic reading "찬란한 너의 계절 | MBC" from <Picture 1>. Ginkgo leaves drift softly between them. The nervous young man with a gentle voice (S1) looks at the woman and asks: <d>[Korean] 나, 좀 기름져 보여?</d> [Shot 2] At 00:01.500, the camera cuts to an extreme close-up of the man’s face and hair. His unwashed hair is exaggeratedly greasy: several dark strands cling together and shine under the warm sunlight. A brief dramatic pause follows. [Shot 3] At 00:03.200, the camera cuts to a medium close-up of the woman. She studies him solemnly, then says in a soft, teasing voice (S2): <d>[Korean] 기름져서 날씨도 맞힐 것 같아.</d> She gently places a single golden ginkgo leaf on top of his oily hair; it sticks firmly in place. [Shot 4] At 00:05.500, the camera cuts back to the two-shot. The woman turns to leave, then looks back over her shoulder and says with affectionate mock seriousness: <d>[Korean] 닉이 추천한 거 좀 들어봐. 기름기 빼고… 그때 나한테 와서 사랑해 줄래?</d> [Shot 5] At 00:09.000, the camera holds a static medium shot of the man standing alone beneath the ginkgo tree. A gust of wind scatters leaves around him, but the leaf on his hair does not move. He stares ahead in embarrassed silence while the bottom-screen graphic remains unchanged.
overall_soundscape: Light autumn wind rustles through the ginkgo leaves, with faint distant street ambience. Leaves flutter past the camera, followed by a tiny sticky sound as the leaf settles onto his hair. The final gust grows briefly louder around the silent man.
non_diegetic_music: Gentle romantic piano and warm strings begin softly. At the woman’s final line, the music switches to an exaggerated melodramatic string swell, then stops abruptly on the final frozen reaction.
